title: Keeping What the Hand Showed: Recording a Demonstration, Resampling It to a Steady Rate, Trimming the Idle Ends, and Checking It Is Worth Keeping

questions.question: Why resample an episode?
options: To make the episode shorter
Messages do not arrive at a steady rate and what uses them wants equal steps
To remove the noise of the joints
To line the leader up with the follower
questions.explanation: A nominal 30 Hz arrived with gaps of up to 0.039 s. Interpolating onto an even grid gives whatever replays or learns from it equal steps.

questions.question: Trimming the idle ends of the episode left:
options: 3.0 s, exactly the reach
5.0 s, nothing: the ends were kept
questions.explanation: A little under the three seconds of the reach, because the slow first and last moments of a smooth move are under the speed threshold.

questions.question: The follower lagged the leader by how much, as found?
options: 39 ms, the longest gap
50 ms, one time constant
0 ms: they were already in step
100 ms
questions.explanation: Sliding the follower's joint back until it best matches the leader's gave the true 100 ms, to within a sample.

questions.question: An episode that lost 20 frames in a row was:
options: Kept, after interpolating across the gap
Kept, with the gap trimmed out
Refused for being too short
Refused: its longest gap was 0.70 s
questions.explanation: Twenty lost frames left 0.70 s with no data, and whatever happened in it would be a guess.

questions.question: Why trim the idle ends?
options: They teach doing nothing, which is not the task
They hold the largest gaps
The follower lags most there
They make the delay harder to find
questions.explanation: A learner copies what it is shown. Seconds of standing still at each end show it that standing still is part of the job.

questions.question: What does the check not say?
options: Whether frames were dropped
How long the episode lasted
Whether the demonstration was a good way to do the task
How much of it was spent idle
questions.explanation: The check is about the recording. Whether the person did the task well is not something a gap or a duration can say.
